method.demand: Multiplicative r=F*dL_per_patch/dF at unchanged SAAM64 output
method.additive: Descriptive g=dL_per_patch/dF at the same SAAM64 output
method.loss: Original Dice+BCE over the full padded128-cubed patch
method.attributes: A is boundary-measurement applicability, not vessel presence or a veto; B is boundary rank ambiguity
method.zA: Fixed normalized CT-predicted A times fixed FIT24 B prior
method.zAB: Fixed normalized CT-predicted A times CT-predicted B
method.fitting: Unregularized FP64 OLS on FIT24 case-equal/16-patch-equal spatial-mean moments;64 channels separately

primary_dual_direction_check.rule: Both increments require12 supported, mean>0, at least8 positive and all3 source means>0

separable_minus_A_only.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

separable_minus_constant.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

multiplicative.sign: r=G0*d(per-patch loss)/dG0; positive r·delta means gain step -delta has negative first-order loss variation

units.moments: Spatial means retain64 separate channels; readout energies and dots also average channels
units.gain_budget: Delta gain field divided by one common FIT24 spatial-and-channel RMS
units.first_variation: -M*64*mean_channel_spatial(r*delta)/FIT_delta_RMS; per-patch derivative already restored, no further factor2
units.derivative: The original B2 loss averages per-sample losses; measurement restores each patch derivative at the fixed SAAM forward, not the original Adam trajectory

separable_minus_A_only.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

separable_minus_constant.normalization: One common FIT24 delta RMS; no probe or case-specific fitting

additive_descriptive.sign: For additive demand g=dL/dF, positive g·delta means additive feature step -delta is a local descent direction

units.moments: Spatial means retain64 separate channels; readout energies and dots also average channels
units.derivative: The original B2 loss averages per-sample losses; measurement restores each patch derivative at the fixed SAAM forward, not the original Adam trajectory
units.feature_budget: Additive feature field divided by one common FIT24 spatial-and-channel RMS; units are feature units, not relative gain

limitations: A local first-order loss direction is not achieved Dice, clDice, finite-step loss improvement or GTA efficacy.
Both multiplicative increment checks are primary; additive results are descriptive and cannot replace or rescue them.
Multiplicative normalized directions have relative-gain units; additive directions have feature units and are not matched budgets.
Absolute energies and descent magnitudes at different layers cannot rank architectures or adaptation sites.
The backbone and prepared heads are frozen and previously trained; TRAIN cases and fixed patches have been reused for development.
All cases, all16 slots including empty/unknown, and all feature sites including padding are retained; overlapping patches are not independent cases.
Zero norms or deficient-rank fits remain undefined, never imputed zero; no feature, support, ridge or threshold search was made.
Ordinary gradient energy and multiplicative-demand energy have different denominators; zero-activation gradient shares do not authorize unfreezing.
No segmentation parameters were updated, no VAL/TEST results were used, and previous negative GTA experiments remain unchanged.
